title: Classic Damage Tilt(旧版受伤抖动)
description: Restores the old non-directional hurt camera effect by removing directional damage tilt.
body:
# Introduction

In Minecraft version 1.19.4, the screen shake effect when taking damage was changed. Classic Damage Tilt is a lightweight Minecraft mod designed for players who prefer the older combat feedback. It restores the pre‑1.19.4 damage tilt effect, bringing back the classic style found in Minecraft 1.19.3 and earlier versions.

 

# Main Features

Restore classic tilt direction: Makes the screen shake no longer follow the direction of incoming attacks.

Compatible with Fabric and Forge.

Plug-and-play: No configuration files needed; works immediately after installation.

 

# Highlights

Purely client-side mod.

 

# Why Choose to Download?

If you’re a veteran player who misses the original combat feedback from earlier Minecraft versions, this mod will bring back that familiar feel.
